partnershipPlan: Two patient partners who used monitoring and one carer review the outcome list and the plain-language summary for the ministry.
socialListening: No social media listening; the programme's patient feedback forms at A and B are summarised in anonymised form.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Knowing someone saw my numbers every morning meant I slept the first week home.
Composite paraphrase: I set up the tablet and did the readings; without me he would not have used it.
items.implication: Count carer dependence as an equity concern.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Half my calls are about a weight change of half a kilo.
items.implication: Measure alert-driven extra contacts as a balancing outcome.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We need a number per readmission avoided and an honest range around it.
items.implication: Lead with the cost per readmission avoided and its interval.

summary: Four composite voices on reassurance, carers, alerts and the payer's needs.
